saw_lines: Used book buyers compare the price with a new copy, then decide on condition before they trust a seller.
So the sale is won or lost at the click, when a buyer needs condition and price answered before leaving.
Your 23 live ads show no proof number, so collect one figure, like your review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 31 Oct 2026
points: None of the 23 ads shows a proof number, so a new buyer has nothing concrete to trust before clicking. Collect one figure, such as your review count or orders shipped, and put it on the next batch of creatives.
Four of your 14 copy ads open on the same line, “proč ti na přečtené knihy”, so no other opener gets a fair test. Test two new openers against it, one on price and one on the quality check.

10 of your Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, so a person who clicked for a book has to search again. That extra step costs the sale. Point each one to its matching section, such as Bestsellery.
None of your 14 copy ads carries an offer, so a first time buyer has no reason to act today. Give new buyers one reason, a first order offer or a bundle, in the opening line of three new ads.

ads_1: Price and quality openers tested against the reading at home hook
